sourceContext.originPage: NZMP ingredient product-detail page (Cheddar Cheese AU)

contentPattern.structure: text cell (H1 + intro + features list + status/sustainability tag pills + CTA) | product image cell (image + small disclaimer)

suitableFor: product/ingredient detail summary heroes (rich text beside a single foreground product render)
two-column intros where the left cell carries the H1, an intro paragraph, a spec/feature list, tag pills and a primary CTA
top-of-page product summaries on a white background
notSuitableFor: full-bleed background-image hero banners (use hero / carousel-banner)
informational image+list features without an H1/CTA (use columns-feature)

usage.reuseNote: application-concept-detail (high-protein-brownie-mix): Reused for the Overview product summary (product render + title/subtitle/intro/primary CTA).
